<mxCell id="header" value="<b>OSINTiger — Intelligence Platform Architecture &amp; Trust Boundaries</b><br>C4 Component Model • Multi-Agent Investigation Pipeline • Immutable Provenance Ledger • AES-256-GCM BYO-Key Vault" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=none;fontColor=#FFFFFF;align=left;spacingLeft=20;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="30" width="1180" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Analyst Boundary --> <mxCell id="analyst-boundary" value="TRUST BOUNDARY: ANALYST WORKBENCH (UNTRUSTED BROWSER CLIENT)" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;strokeColor=#94A3B8;fillColor=#F8FAFC;fontColor=#64748B;fontSize=11;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="120" width="1180" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="workbench" value="<b>Investigation Workbench</b><br>Query intake, target formulation" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="analyst-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="25" y="34" width="265" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="graph-explorer" value="<b>Entity Graph Explorer</b><br>Force-directed relationship canvas" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="analyst-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="315" y="34" width="265" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="evidence-matrix" value="<b>Evidence Matrix &amp; Ledger</b><br>Immutable provenance hashes" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="analyst-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="605" y="34" width="265" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ach-view" value="<b>ACH &amp; Report View</b><br>Hypotheses matrix, analyst sign-off" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#3B82F6;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="analyst-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="895" y="34" width="260" height="66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Application Server Boundary --> <mxCell id="app-boundary" value="APPLICATION SERVER: INVESTIGATION PIPELINE &amp; MULTI-AGENT ENGINE" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;strokeWidth=2;fillColor=#FFFFFF;fontColor=#6D28D9;fontSize=12;startSize=30;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="275" width="810" height="435" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="orchestrator" value="<b>Pipeline Orchestrator</b><br>• State machine coordinator<br>• Parallel source task runner" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="48" width="240" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="normalizer" value="<b>Evidence Normalizer</b><br>• Raw telemetry payload parser<br>• Canonical schema mapping" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F3FF;strokeColor=#8B5CF6;fontColor=#4C1D95;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="285" y="48" width="240" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="provenance" value="<b>Provenance &amp; Attribution</b><br>• SHA-256 payload hash<br>• Immutable attribution chain" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="550" y="48" width="240" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="entity-res" value="<b>Entity Resolution Engine</b><br>• Cross-source linking<br>• Jaro-Winkler alias matching" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EEF2FF;strokeColor=#6366F1;fontColor=#1E1B4B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="155" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ach-engine" value="<b>ACH &amp; Multi-Agent Debate</b><br>• Competing hypotheses matrix<br>• Cross-examiner agent" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ECFDF5;strokeColor=#10B981;fontColor=#064E3B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="285" y="155" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vault" value="<b>BYO-Key Cryptographic Vault</b><br>• AES-256-GCM cipher<br>• 96-bit IV + 128-bit auth tag" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFBEB;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="550" y="155" width="240" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="guardrails" value="<b>Zero-Hallucination Guardrail &amp; Citation Enforcement Layer</b><br>Every assertion in generated reports must link to a valid Evidence ID with an immutable SHA-256 hash" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#64748B;fontColor=#1E293B;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;" vertex="1" parent="app-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="270" width="770" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- External Sources Boundary --> <mxCell id="sources-boundary" value="EXTERNAL INTELLIGENCE DATA SOURCES" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;dashed=1;dashPattern=6 4;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fillColor=#FFF1F2;fontColor=#E11D48;fontSize=11;startSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="875" y="275" width="345" height="435" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tier1" value="<b>Tier 1: Regulatory &amp; Sanctions</b><br>• OFAC SDN, OpenCorporates, SEC" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="sources-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="42" width="308" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tier2" value="<b>Tier 2: Infrastructure &amp; Telemetry</b><br>• crt.sh CT logs, IPinfo, DNS" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="sources-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="134" width="308" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tier3" value="<b>Tier 3: Blockchain &amp; Public Leaks</b><br>• Etherscan, ICIJ Offshore Leaks" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#F43F5E;fontColor=#9F1239;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="sources-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="226" width="308" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llm-tier" value="<b>External LLM Inference Boundary</b><br>• OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Ollama<br>• Ephemeral in-memory key injection" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FEF3C7;strokeColor=#D97706;fontColor=#92400E;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="sources-boundary"> <mxGeometry x="18" y="318" width="308" height="98" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

g.text: OSINTiger — Intelligence Platform Architecture & Trust Boundaries
C4 Component Model • Multi-Agent Investigation Pipeline • Immutable Provenance Ledger • AES-256-GCM BYO-Key Vault
TRUST BOUNDARY: ANALYST WORKBENCH (UNTRUSTED BROWSER CLIENT)
APPLICATION SERVER: INVESTIGATION PIPELINE & MULTI-AGENT ENGINE
• Deterministic verification gate: Every assertion in generated reports must link to a valid Evidence ID
• Unverified claims lacking immutable provenance hashes are flagged UNVERIFIED or pruned from intelligence briefs
Human-in-the-Loop Review Boundary (Analyst Overrides & Final Dossier Export)
Allows lead investigator to adjust hypothesis confidence scores, document dissenting judgments, and export PDF/JSON/CSV
• SEC EDGAR filings, FEC campaign finance
• Decrypted BYO API keys passed per call
• Zero model training on customer investigations
PERSISTENCE LAYER: KNOWLEDGE BASE, EVIDENCE LEDGER & GRAPH STORE
